    $$\nu_1 = 10Dq \implies 4,070 \text{ cm}^{-1} = 10Dq \implies Dq = 407 \text{ cm}^{-1}$$
    The fit provides a precise value of approximately **$406.8 \text{ cm}^{-1}$**.

2.  **Racah Parameter ($B$):**
    The positions of the $^4T_1(F)$ and $^4T_1(P)$ bands depend on both $Dq$ and $B$. Fitting these observed values to the Tanabe-Sugano equations for a $d^3/d^7$ system yields a Racah parameter $B$ of approximately **$748.4 \text{ cm}^{-1}$**.

- $Dq = 406.8 \text{ cm}^{-1}$
- $B = 748.4 \text{ cm}^{-1}$
